SYMPTOM 1: Docker builds fail with 'no space left on device' or Playwright /tmp full
CAUSE: Build cache + intermediate layers accumulate, Playwright Chromium profiles fill /tmp
FIX: docker system prune -af --volumes (freed 5.3GB in this session). Also add tmpfs mount to Playwright container.

SYMPTOM 2: Vinted API returns 403 or token errors from within Docker after heavy testing
CAUSE: Vinted blocks datacenter/container IPs; also IP-level rate limiting after many requests
FIX: Wait 5-10 mins for rate limit to clear. Host machine requests work even when Docker is blocked. Verify with: curl -s 'https://www.vinted.lt/api/v2/catalog/items?...' from host.
